scope: Transformer, official Mamba-3 SISO, Mamba4; no 125M scaling
training_replay_reason: GPT2 tokenization after document holdout yields998868400 unique training targets; complete the budget using a fresh training-only document permutation, seed43
primary_metric: heldout mean next-token negative log likelihood in natural logarithm units
screen_win: Mamba4 final heldout NLL strictly lower than each peer, with finite training and improved NLL relative to initialization
stability: Every optimizer-step loss and global gradient norm finite; checkpoint states independently hash checked
recall: Frozen synthetic key/value text prompts with distractors, candidate likelihood accuracy and loss; report all peers as diagnostic, without tuning on these prompts
latency: Measure compiled prefill/training throughput, cached decode where implemented, compiler cost analysis and observed peak device memory; speed is reported without a minimum speedup gate
fairness: Shared tokenizer, tied embedding vocabulary/width, seed, source order, exact budget, batch, length, optimizer/schedule and heldout documents; total and nonembedding counts matched within1percent
uncertainty: One training seed is a screen and cannot estimate between-seed variability. Retain losses and failed runs; a failed win does not authorize scaling
